subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: Should maintainers split this broad report into focused canonical issues, or keep it as the umbrella for CLI default-session routing, WeChat/plugin-boundary proof, inter-session delivery, and background-event isolation?
rationale: The report combines core TUI defaults, generic `sessions_send` delivery, external WeChat plugin proof, and product-level activity taxonomy, so automation should not choose the tracking shape or activity model.

options.title: Split into focused canonicals
options.body: Track `sessions_send` in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255, meaningful activity in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, and keep or create a smaller item for TUI default-session creation and event-flood isolation.

options.title: Keep this umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordinating item and require any fix path to prove CLI/TUI, channel plugin, `sessions_send`, and background-event behavior together.

recommendation.title: Split into focused canonicals
recommendation.body: Track `sessions_send` in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93255, meaningful activity in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, and keep or create a smaller item for TUI default-session creation and event-flood isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: The current blame and recent recipient-session work make this the best available routing owner for the maintainer choice.
